_what_this_is: MISUSE REGISTER. A distinct control purpose from the claims register, which governs what JRS may SAY, and from the security register, which governs what an attacker may DO. This governs what an HONEST user may WRONGLY CONCLUDE. Every row records the control that actually exists today, and says NONE where none exists rather than describing an intention.
_principle: Use the minimum control that meaningfully prevents or exposes the misuse. Product friction added to demonstrate diligence is itself a cost, and a control nobody can act on is decoration. NONE OF THESE CONTROLS PREVENT MISUSE ABSOLUTELY; they mitigate identified modes and make several detectable.

misuses.misuse: JRS output treated as legal approval
misuses.harm: Unsupported legal reliance on a documentation review
misuses.control: Claims register C-004/C-007/C-008 prohibit it; every engine response carries its own disclaimer; check_data_handling_claims_match_the_implementation bans the formulations across 76 pages
misuses.warning: Present in the engine payload and on the public pages
misuses.detection: Guard-level on our own surfaces only
misuses.residual: WE CANNOT DETECT A CUSTOMER MISREPRESENTING OUR OUTPUT DOWNSTREAM. No control reaches that, and claiming otherwise would be the same error this register exists to catch
misuses.status: CONTROLLED ON OUR SURFACES, UNCONTROLLABLE DOWNSTREAM

misuses.misuse: JRS treated as certification or accreditation
misuses.harm: False assurance; a credential claimed that does not exist
misuses.control: C-005 prohibits it; check_evaluation_offers_no_certificate pins wantsCert=false in api/reviewer-eval.js AND bans certificate copy on the funnel pages, two independent conditions
misuses.residual: Training completion produces recognition, not certification. The distinction is maintained in copy and is a live misreading risk

misuses.misuse: The routing result treated as the decision itself
misuses.harm: Human judgment displaced by a documentation-condition evaluation
misuses.control: manifest.human_review.required is HARDCODED TRUE and is a schema-REQUIRED field, so a manifest asserting no human review is invalid rather than merely discouraged
misuses.warning: Carried in the manifest itself, not only in documentation
misuses.residual: A human can read 'ready' and stop reading. The field records the requirement; it cannot enforce the reading

misuses.misuse: JRS used to justify discriminatory treatment of an individual
misuses.harm: Civil-rights exposure, and a documentation tool lending false objectivity to an outcome someone had already decided
misuses.control: NONE. Searching the public estate for discrimination-related guidance returns one investigator guide and one article source, neither of which is a control on USE
misuses.residual: THE LARGEST UNCONTROLLED MISUSE MODE IN THIS REGISTER, and it is recorded as such. JRS evaluates whether a record explains itself. A record can be perfectly reconstructable and describe a discriminatory decision, and JRS would route it 'ready'. That is not a defect in the evaluation; it is a boundary of what the evaluation means, and nothing currently states that boundary to a user.
misuses.proposed: A single sentence of scope language, on the engine surfaces and in the manifest specification: a reconstructable record is not a defensible decision, and JRS evaluates the record rather than the decision. This is documentation, within delegated authority, and is QUEUED rather than written into a deployable page in this cycle.

misuses.misuse: An obsolete JRS or Codebook version treated as current
misuses.harm: A historical evaluation read under today's meaning
misuses.control: The manifest carries jrs_version, codebook_version, engine.version and manifest_version; the release register now holds a version inventory tied to code
misuses.warning: Version fields are present and schema-required
misuses.detection: PARTIAL. X-9 remains open: jrs_version and codebook_version are caller-supplied and validated only for presence, so a version that never existed can be asserted

misuses.harm: Evidence integrity destroyed while the artifact still looks authentic
misuses.control: integrity.manifest_hash over a declared canonicalization; tools/validate-manifest.js recomputes it
misuses.residual: A HASH IS NOT A SIGNATURE. Anyone can regenerate a modified manifest AND its hash. Detection works only against a copy someone else holds, or against a hash recorded elsewhere. This is the difference between integrity and authenticity and it must never be blurred

misuses.harm: A qualified result presented as unqualified
misuses.control: Removal changes the canonical form and therefore the hash
misuses.detection: Via hash recomputation, with the same limit as M-6
misuses.residual: `warnings` is NOT a schema-required field, because a manifest with nothing to warn about legitimately has none. So an ABSENT warnings array is valid and indistinguishable from one that never existed, unless a prior copy is held
misuses.status: DETECTABLE ONLY AGAINST A PRIOR COPY

misuses.misuse: Development test results represented as validation
misuses.harm: An unvalidated engine described as validated
misuses.control: C-004 prohibits it; the engine declares its own stage as unvalidated IN EVERY RESPONSE; the continuity index and research records preserve the failed pre-registered reliability criterion
misuses.detection: Human review per the 2026-09-15 decision; a naive term scan produced false positives on version strings and negations

misuses.misuse: Research results represented as universal effectiveness or real-world prevalence
misuses.harm: A constructed corpus presented as a population finding
misuses.control: C-003 prohibits a real-world deficit rate; BD-07 publishes the DISTRIBUTION rather than a favourable single run; check_research_summary_leads_with_its_boundaries fails the build if the headline figure is moved above its limitations
misuses.warning: Boundaries printed ABOVE the figure, by guard

misuses.misuse: The integrity hash represented as authentication
misuses.harm: A self-generated artifact treated as proven to come from JRS
misuses.control: The continuity index states it; the claims register prohibits it as C-16
misuses.residual: GAP FOUND AND CLOSED IN THIS CYCLE: lib/manifest/build.js, the file an implementer actually reads when integrating, said nothing about it. The statement now sits beside the code that creates the field
